hub.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
hub.text: State your business and your sponsor, or stand aside for the next in line.

options.text: I need clearance for the forge tier.
Any word from the exam floor?
The exam's done. About that stamp.
A vial of tempering oil, if you're headed to the floor. (12 gold)
The stamp clerk endorsed the entry side. Countersign the release.

options._comment: #438 EQUIPMENT GAPS, the two forge-tier retail rows. APPENDED LAST and gated on `pallass_entry_stamped` exactly like the tempering-oil arm above, so they are HIDDEN at every fixture that has not stamped in -- the same shape that kept the oil arm off the earlier pins. Prices are the catalog prices (items.json guardsmans_pike 18, weighted_apron 12), posted-price like everything else this clerk sells: he records fees, he does not haggle.
options.text: One of the wall-company pikes off the rack. (18 gold)
A bench apron, the weighted kind. (12 gold)

pike_sold.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
pike_sold.text: Rack stock, stamped at the collar. That stamp is the whole of what you are buying from me — an unstamped haft gets you turned around at the lift, and I would rather not have that conversation twice in one shift.

apron_sold.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
apron_sold.text: Lead in the hem. It hangs straight and it stops a spark, and it is not armour, which is the answer if anyone up here asks you what it is.

tempering_sold.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
tempering_sold.text: Posted price, paid in full. Work it into the edge the night before you need it. Questions of application go to the smiths on the floor. I sell the flask and record the fee.

permit_intro.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_intro.text: Five gold, filed same-day, no exceptions and no discounts: that is the posted price. Grimalkin reads your fitness afterward, at the exam floor on the far end of this office. I only handle paper.

permit_filed_reaction.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_filed_reaction.text: Filed. Grimalkin is at the exam floor, far end of this office. See him before you come back asking about a stamp.

permit_status.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_status.text: Filed and pending. Grimalkin reads the fitness; he is at the exam floor, far end of this office. This window stamps after he signs. Until his mark arrives, the file sits in my tray.

collect_stamp.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
collect_stamp.text: Grimalkin's mark is on the file. Three gold for the stamp itself: posted price, same as the filing.

stamp_reaction.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
stamp_reaction.text: Stamped. The lift answers to it now. Do not lose the paper. This office does not file duplicates.

queue_release.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
queue_release.text: The release is held pending requisitions filed with the Supply Office, two tiers down. However, an endorsed entry outranks a held release. The rule is posted beside the door, and it has been posted there longer than I have held this window. There is no recorded use of it.

queue_release_why.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
queue_release_why.text: Because you have to walk to the other office first, and everybody assumes the answer is no. On most days that assumption is correct. Today you arrive with an endorsement, and the rule applies.

queue_release_done.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
queue_release_done.text: Countersigned. Take it to the consignee. She signs last. The copy stays in my tray; the sheet she signs travels with you.
